correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Catalan first-return generating function F=(1-sqrt(1-4z))/2 and bridge B=1/sqrt(1-4z). Marking one primitive excursion in the mean bridge energy yields E[Q_exc|semilength m]=m(2m-1) for either sign. Given ordered M, independent fair signs give E[X^2|M]=sum m_i^2 and additive energy gives E[Q|M]=2 sum m_i^2-n, proving E[Q-2X^2|M]=-n for every composition, not merely K. Differentiating the K- and X-marked generating series gives Cov(K,X^2)=-n(n-1)4^n/(12 binom(2n,n)); Stirling gives -sqrt(pi)n^(5/2)/12. Independently enumerated every balanced path n<=7, verified all conditional composition groups and covariance. The analytic formal-series proof, not these bounded checks, covers every n.

value.rationale: A conditional structural identity relating physically distinct height-energy and signed-occupation observables for every fixed return-time composition is a motivated new bridge-functional tool. The universal h(M) covariance transfer is independently useful in renewal/occupation theory; the strictly negative return-count covariance gives a sharp quantitative application, not merely a textbook restatement.

limitations: Uniform simple nearest-neighbor bridges only; signs unconditioned; Q is interior sum and X is odd-time sign sum.
